u0: Initial carrying phase: the box is in your hands and the first automatic fall has not happened yet. Head for the green exit, since stepping onto it while holding the box completes the task; if the box falls, switch to immediate recovery and make pickup your next action.
u1: The box has just fallen and your hands are empty; the fall has turned you to face its landing cell. Your next move must be pickup. A successful pickup returns you to carrying and heading for the exit; doing anything else misses the recovery window and fails the task.
u2: You have recovered the box after a fall and are carrying it again on the way to the exit. Keep possession and continue toward the goal, because reaching the exit while holding the box succeeds. A later fall may occur; if it does, your very next action must be pickup.
u3: A later fall has just occurred: the box is out of your hands and you face its landing cell. Pick it up with the very next action. Success resumes the final carrying phase; any other action or delay leads to failure.
u4: You have recovered from the later fall and are holding the box again. No further automatic fall is scheduled, so keep the box and proceed to the green exit. Stepping onto the exit while holding the box is the terminal success condition.
u5: Failure sink: the box was not back in your hands on the move immediately after a fall, so the required recovery was missed. This absorbing failed state cannot reach the success condition or earn the exit reward, even if the box is later picked up.
u6: Terminal success: you have reached the exit while holding the box. The task is complete and no further objective remains.
